objective: Make every owner-issued Minecraft goal visibly traceable beside the natural-language form: show bounded planner, allowlist, controller and postcondition stages with timings and final errors while preserving the existing deterministic gameplay authority.
non_goals: Do not expose, persist or log hidden chain-of-thought, raw model output, the full system prompt, secrets, tokens, Mineflayer objects, raw inventory, coordinates, generated code or action sequences.
Do not add a new gameplay goal, manual action button, planner retry, controller retry, pathfinding, crafting, combat, viewer authority or widget authority.
Do not change the existing model, model parameters, Safety decision, action allowlist or Minecraft controller behavior.
contracts: Electron main emits only a fixed, validated workflow-event schema to the trusted operator renderer and logs the same bounded stages to the owner terminal.

The trace identifies the public planner profile/version, fixed output schema, selected allowlisted goal, controller start/result, durations and stable failure detail; it never claims to be raw model reasoning.

Renderer retention is memory-only, resets per owner submission and remains bounded; the trace is visible immediately beside the goal form so final controller failures cannot be hidden above the current scroll position.
acceptance_criteria: Submitting a goal immediately shows request/planner progress, then selected-goal and controller/postcondition result or the exact bounded error beside the form.
The owner terminal receives one bounded structured line per workflow stage with a workflow ID and no raw prompt, hidden reasoning, secret or raw model output.
Preload rejects malformed or oversized progress events before invoking renderer code, and widget/non-operator surfaces still cannot issue or observe Minecraft workflows.
Existing Minecraft behavior, typed loopback boundaries, Safety feature gate and one-goal allowlist remain unchanged.

latency_or_quality_budget.event_overhead: at most eight small in-memory progress records per request; no network request or model call is added
latency_or_quality_budget.retention: renderer memory and owner terminal only for the running session; no workflow trace file, prompt or model output persistence
latency_or_quality_budget.privacy: user-entered goal remains in the existing textarea; trace contains no prompt body, chain-of-thought, credentials or raw game state
